all.source_quote: Applicant should be above 18 years of age

unmodelled.source_quote: The applicant must be an Indian citizen

unmodelled.text: Must run a non-corporate, non-farm micro or small enterprise
unmodelled.source_quote: Should be a non-corporate, non-farm micro or small enterprise (e.g., shopkeepers, traders, manufacturers, service providers)

unmodelled.text: The business must earn income and not be mainly agriculture
unmodelled.source_quote: The business must be income-generating and engaged in business activities (not agriculture as primary activity)

unmodelled.text: Must not be a defaulter to any bank or financial institution
unmodelled.source_quote: Must not be a defaulter to any bank or financial institution
Should have a viable business plan or proposal for starting or expanding a business

unmodelled.text: Existing businesses, startups and first-time entrepreneurs can all apply
unmodelled.source_quote: Existing small businesses, startups, and first-time entrepreneurs are also eligible

ambiguous: Source is a short summary by the Department of Information & Cultural Affairs on wb.gov.in, not the scheme's own guidelines
'Above 18 years of age' is read as older than 18; it may mean 18 or older

en.title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
en.benefit: Collateral-free business loans up to Rs 10 lakh (Shishu, Kishore and Tarun categories).
en.how_to_apply: Apply at a bank, MFI or NBFC that offers MUDRA loans, or online through their portal, with a business plan.
